youtube.description:
Sing Rain, Rain, Go Away with Robo, Bunny, Ducky and Pip! Rumble, rumble, pop, pop, pop: the umbrellas open and the rain comes down. Each friend gets one piece of rain gear: a green hat for Robo, a yellow raincoat for Bunny, a blue umbrella for Ducky (guess the colour before it pops open!) and red boots for Pip. Count the puddles, jump on splash, and sing hello to the sun when the rain goes away.

What your child learns: the weather words rain and sun, the colours green, yellow, blue and red on rain gear (hat, raincoat, umbrella and boots), and counting to three.

Sing at home: put on a pretend hat, zip up a pretend coat, guess the umbrella's colour with a 3, 2, 1, and jump when you hear "splash!". Rain, Rain, Go Away is a traditional public-domain rhyme sung to its traditional tune; the verses about the hat, the coat, the umbrella, the boots and the sun are original words written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Uh-oh, rain! Let's sing with our friends!
A hat, a coat, an umbrella... and a surprise!
Robo wants to play! Sing with me!
Drip, drop! My head is wet!
What colour is my hat? Say green!
Drip, drop, rain, I'm dry instead,
Splish and splash and jump ahead,
Who's coming? Hop, hop... it's Bunny!
What colour is the coat? Say yellow!
Not a drop and not a drip,
Button up and hop and skip,
What colour is it inside? Guess!
Here comes Pip! Pip loves puddles!
Pip needs boots for splashing! The surprise!
What colour are the boots? Say red!
In the puddles, jump and romp,
One, two, three, and splash, splash, splash,
Your turn! Jump when I say splash!
Where are the red boots? Point to them!
Yes! The red boots! Stomp, stomp!
Which one is blue? Point to it!
Look! The rain is going away!
All my friends come out to play,
